chapters.title: Chapter 5238: Veiled Causal Site I
paragraphs: The results of Noah’s actions began to unfold.

THE Infiniverse responded to six simultaneous catalysts the way a prepared environment responded to precisely the right combination of inputs, not with the gradual accumulation of change but with the specific sudden expression of change that had been building toward a threshold and had just crossed it.
The first things to emerge were the trees.

They arrived, as if THE Infinite Tongue had spoken their existence into the substrate and they had simply agreed to be there, rising from the Infinity-saturated ground of multiple Realms simultaneously in configurations that made the concept of Yggdrasil feel preliminary!

Each tree was enormous in the way of things that had been given Infinite catalysts rather than ordinary growth conditions, their trunks wider than most structures Noah had encountered across his life, their canopies extending upward into the upper atmospheric layers of THE Infiniverse and spreading outward to cover territories the size of Folds!

Their bark carried the multicolored luminescence of THE Infiniverse’s ambient Infinity, each ring of it a different color, each color corresponding to a different Cause or Civilization or truth that the tree had incorporated into its growth as it rose.
Their roots drove downward through the substrate with the reach of things that were looking for the deepest available source of nourishment and intended to find it.
The Primordial Realms followed.
|THE Infiniverse- Primordial Realm emergence commencing.|
|Six Miniature Infinite Causes have exceeded the threshold required to catalyze Primordial Realm formation. The following Primordial Realms are emerging:|

|THE Realm of Duat: Drawing from the concept of the luminous upper domain that sits above all mortal arrangement, this Primordial Realm is forming in THE Infiniverse’s highest atmospheric layer as a space of concentrated Infinity where the boundary between cultivated power and pure Cause expression is thinner than anywhere else in the domain.Beings who enter Orun will find their Cause connections amplified and their comprehension of Prime Causes accelerated.Drawing from the concept of the domain of becoming, where existence undergoes transformation rather than cessation, this Primordial Realm is simultaneously forming in the deeper substrate layers of THE Infiniverse as a space specifically optimized for existential engineering and refinement.Nascent Hadean transformation processes that occur within Duat will complete at accelerated rates.|

|THE Realm of Patala: With the mindset of a creative domain, where the foundational substrate of existence is most concentrated and most malleable, this Primordial Realm is forming at the convergence point of three Infinite Observable Trees as a space where Civilizations can be actualized at rates that THE Absolute Forge of Infinity’s ordinary timeline does not produce. This realm is also existing below many in a relationship of foundational support rather than hierarchy, this Primordial Realm is forming at THE Infiniverse’s deepest available stratum as a space connected to the most concentrated Infinity available anywhere in the domain. The Infinite Flood catalyst has filled Patala with Infinity-rich substance at densities approaching what THE Braneworld Observable Existence carries.|

|Growth velocity has increased. THE Infiniverse is utilizing every available resource to accelerate the transition toward Observable Existence standing. THE Infinite Culmination Directive is being honored at maximum operational capacity.|
|Estimated acceleration of development timeline: significant. Precise projection unavailable due to the unprecedented nature.|
|She...is trying her best, Master.|
Ruination stood up for THE Infiniverse at this time as if to tell Noah they really were doing everything and exceeding, but the process simply took time!
Noah looked at THE Realms forming in the layers above him, its luminous golden substance pressing outward into the upper atmosphere of THE Infiniverse.

He looked at the Infinite Observable Trees rising across the Realms below and beside and above him, their canopies beginning to touch each other at the upper reaches, the first connections between separate trees forming the beginning of a continuous canopy that would eventually cover THE Infiniverse the way a civilization’s infrastructure eventually covered the landscape it had been built within.
He pressed his feet deeper into the golden sand as he breathed out. At some points, one had to take a moment...to just breathe.
While one body observed the progression of THE Infiniverse in relaxation.
In THE Braneworld Observable Existence, countless miles from Velanthra and from every familiar reference point Noah had managed to accumulate since his entry, the procession moved.

He followed Ubergulden Adelheid and Sororis Prima Evangelina through the exterior of the vessel onto the obsidian floating platform that served as their anchor point, the air here carrying the quality of THE Braneworld at its most concentrated, the Observable Force density pressing against every surface with the patient insistence of a medium that knew its own significance.
Behind Evangelina’s delegation and the attending Custodes, Dietrich moved with the unhurried authority of a being who owned the sky he walked upon and found no reason to pretend otherwise.
His eyes found Noah’s position every thirty seconds or so.
Noah looked back at him with the serene expression of an innocent man.
Which he was, essentially. In the relevant sense!

In the sense that Dietrich had no verified information about anything Noah had done recently, and verified information was the only kind that produced legitimate suspicion. The fact that Noah had, in the preceding time, compressed a Sororis Prima into a sphere and eaten her whole, devoured approximately a few hundred Ordovician Paleozoic Scale Gilded Ones, collapsed at the hands of a Silurian Paleozoic Ragnar clone and detonated across a gigaparsec radius on the way down, and scattered the assembled Gilded forces of Gilded Ones to the most inhospitable coordinates Observable Existence had available...was information that Ubergulden Dietrich did not possess.
He also did not know that the Sororis Prima Adelheid had once referred to as a friend had tried to have Noah killed.
So she had died. Cause and effect. Basic!
Noah was innocent!
He smiled pleasantly at Dietrich’s continued scrutiny and returned his attention to what was in front of him.
And then he blinked for a moment because what was in front of him required stopping for.
The Veiled Causal Site stretched outward in every direction.

Vibrant auroras of obsidian-gold light swept across the surrounding space in massive slow-turning arcs that covered more territory than Noah’s immediate perception could fully track, the auroras not merely decorative but carrying the specific quality of Cause authority broadcasting itself through a medium it had thoroughly saturated.

Incandescent obsidian-gold rivers flowed between the auroras in continuous currents, rivers that did not require channels or gravity to maintain their trajectories but moved according to the specific patterns of a Prime Cause pulling its own expression through the ambient space.
And the citadels.

They floated throughout the Site, each one a structure of obsidian-gold that carried the architectural ambition of beings who had decided that the expression of a Prime Cause required a physical form worthy of it.

They rose in vertical configurations of stacked platforms and soaring towerd, each platform carrying its own clustered structures, each tower rising from those structures toward the ones above it until the full citadel occupied vertical territory that measured in light years from base platform to highest point.
Their surfaces were smooth and absolute in the way that obsidian was smooth and absolute, but carrying the gold threading of...yes, THE Mortis Cause.
THE Mortis Cause!
Every surface breathed.

That was the only word for it. The gold threading along the obsidian pulsed in slow rhythms that suggested respiration, the Prime Cause light moving through the citadels’ structures in cycles that carried the specific cadence of something alive operating according to its foundational truth.
THE Mortis Cause. The truth that existence concludes.
The citadels burned with ending, and they were magnificent!

In THE Braneworld Observable Existence, countless miles from Velanthra and from every familiar reference point Noah had managed to accumulate since his entry, the procession moved.

He followed Ubergulden Adelheid and Sororis Prima Evangelina through the exterior of the vessel onto the obsidian floating platform that served as their anchor point, the air here carrying the quality of THE Braneworld at its most concentrated, the Observable Force density pressing against every surface with the patient insistence of a medium that knew its own significance.
Behind Evangelina’s delegation and the attending Custodes, Dietrich moved with the unhurried authority of a being who owned the sky he walked upon and found no reason to pretend otherwise.
His eyes found Noah’s position every thirty seconds or so.
Noah looked back at him with the serene expression of an innocent man.
Which he was, essentially.
In the relevant sense!
In the sense that Dietrich had no verified information about anything Noah had done recently, and verified information was the only kind that produced legitimate suspicion.

The fact that Noah had, in the preceding time, compressed a Sororis Prima into a sphere and eaten her whole, devoured approximately a few hundred Ordovician Paleozoic Scale Gilded Ones, collapsed at the hands of a Silurian Paleozoic Ragnar clone and detonated across a gigaparsec radius on the way down, and scattered the assembled Gilded forces of Gilded Ones to the most inhospitable coordinates Observable Existence had available...was information that Ubergulden Dietrich did not possess.
He also did not know that the Sororis Prima Adelheid had once referred to as a friend had tried to have Noah killed.
So she had died.
Cause and effect.
Basic!
Noah was innocent!
He smiled pleasantly at Dietrich’s continued scrutiny and returned his attention to what was in front of him.
And then he blinked for a moment because what was in front of him required stopping for.
The Veiled Causal Site stretched outward in every direction.

Vibrant auroras of obsidian-gold light swept across the surrounding space in massive slow-turning arcs that covered more territory than Noah’s immediate perception could fully track, the auroras not merely decorative but carrying the specific quality of Cause authority broadcasting itself through a medium it had thoroughly saturated.

Incandescent obsidian-gold rivers flowed between the auroras in continuous currents, rivers that did not require channels or gravity to maintain their trajectories but moved according to the specific patterns of a Prime Cause pulling its own expression through the ambient space.
And the citadels.

They floated throughout the Site, each one a structure of obsidian-gold that carried the architectural ambition of beings who had decided that the expression of a Prime Cause required a physical form worthy of it.

They rose in vertical configurations of stacked platforms and soaring towerd, each platform carrying its own clustered structures, each tower rising from those structures toward the ones above it until the full citadel occupied vertical territory that measured in light years from base platform to highest point.
Their surfaces were smooth and absolute in the way that obsidian was smooth and absolute, but carrying the gold threading of...yes, THE Mortis Cause.
THE Mortis Cause!
Every surface breathed.
That was the only word for it.

The gold threading along the obsidian pulsed in slow rhythms that suggested respiration, the Prime Cause light moving through the citadels’ structures in cycles that carried the specific cadence of something alive operating according to its foundational truth.
THE Mortis Cause.
The truth that existence concludes.
The citadels burned with ending, and they were magnificent!

chapters.title: Chapter 5239: Veiled Causal Site II
paragraphs: At this time as he looked at everything, Adelheid’s voice arrived in Noah’s mind.
’What you are perceiving areTHE Terminus Citadels. You are looking at eight of them from this angle, though there are more beyond the immediate perimeter.’
Her mental voice carried the quality of her physical voice elevated into pure precision, each word arriving with deliberateness.

’This entire region was constructed during the Fourth Age. Ancient Gilded Ones, among the most powerful our civilization has produced across its history, identified nine locations within THE Braneworld Observable Existence where the specific conditions of dimensional density and existential substrate permitted the concentration of Prime Cause light from THE First Cause into a stable persistent presence.’

’They did not create the Prime Cause expressions here. They pulled them. They gathered the ambient resonance of each Prime Cause from across THE Braneworld and directed it into these nine Sites, compressing the ambient into concentrated, and then they built around the concentration rather than within it.’
The procession moved toward the tallest structure at the Site’s approximate center.
Around it, thousands of Ira Gilded Ones circulated in slow orbital formations at varying heights.

Other Gilded Ones moved within the citadels’ lower platforms, their forms visible through the obsidian-gold surfaces in silhouette, conducting whatever function brought them to a Site built around the most unwelcome Prime Cause in the arrangement of existence.
Evangelina’s party moved through the circling Ira formations with the specific ease of beings whose status produced automatic clearance, the Ira parting before them.

’THE Terminus Citadels are what this Site is called in formal Gilded designation. What they contain, and what they were built to serve as the vessel for, is THE Mortis Cause. The eighth Prime Cause. The foundational truth that existence concludes.’

Adelheid walked beside Noah at a distance appropriate to the Custos arrangement, her gaze forward and her posture carrying the quality of someone engaged in a private communication that the observer could sense but not access.
She moved through the obsidian-gold light with natural ease.

’Understand what this means. Every death that has ever occurred, every Civilization that has ever fallen, every relationship that has ever concluded, every moment of finality across the full span of existence draws its experiential legitimacy from this Cause. THE Mortis Cause does not cause death. Death draws its authority from THE Mortis Cause. The distinction matters. The Cause is prior to the phenomenon. The phenomenon derives from the Cause.’

The tallest structure rose before them now with the specific verticality of something designed to be perceived from far away and to be more impressive upon arrival than it had been at distance, which was a significant claim given how impressive it had been at distance.

’The Pulses it permits are among the most feared in the documented history of the Gilded. THE Mortis Whisper implants the absolute certainty of impending death into the target’s consciousness at a foundational level, not as a belief to be argued with but as a truth their existence begins to act on before their conscious mind has finished processing the delivery.’

’Their existence begins to unravel in anticipation of a conclusion that may never actually arrive. THE Mortis Touch introduces ending into whatever is physically contacted, causing the touched substance to begin concluding regardless of its prior durability or resistance. And then there is THE Mortis Sovereignty.’
She paused.

’THE Mortis Sovereignty is a terminal expression that makes the caster the temporary embodiment of ending itself. Everything within their presence that is capable of concluding begins to conclude simultaneously. Individual cells. Civilizations. The structural foundations of the region the caster occupies. All of them receive the signal that their continuation has reached its designated terminus. All of them honor the signal because the signal comes from the Cause rather than from a being, and the Cause cannot be argued with by anything that draws its authority from the Cause’s foundational truth, which is everything in existence.’

They were close enough now that the individual architectural details of the tallest structure were visible, its surface carrying elaborate dimensional geometries etched into the obsidian that Noah’s Pillow Talk registered as functional rather than decorative, the geometries serving as the structural architecture of the Mortis Cause concentration rather than as ornamentation.

’No Gilded designation draws from THE Mortis Cause as its primary amplification. This was a deliberate choice embedded in the earliest engineering methodologies, the recognition that anchoring any population’s identity in the truth of ending produced...psychological conditions that were difficult to grasp. No Gilded One likes to be told all things end and all things die, even them. So what exists instead is THE Mortis Sorora.’
The name arrived with the specific weight of something significant being named.

’A secretive cadre within THE Magna Sorora itself, Sisters who have been authorized to cultivate direct connections to THE Mortis Cause for the purpose of administering the executions the Sisterhood occasionally requires. Their existence is not publicly acknowledged.’
Noah kept his expression neutral as he listened.

’THE Mortis Cause is the only Prime Cause whose experiential truth cannot be permanently resisted. Every other Cause can be countered by a sufficiently powerful opposing Cause. THE Mortis Cause asserts that ending comes for everything, and this assertion has never been falsified across the full history of existence. The beings who have touched this Cause most deeply wield the one truth that no cultivation, no engineering, no Ego, and no Primordial Source has ever ultimately overridden.’
The entrance of the tallest structure was ahead, Evangelina and her delegation already moving through it, the Ira guards at the flanks maintaining their positions.
’We have arrived.’
Her mental voice carried the slightest adjustment in its register.
’Do your best to behave. If you are feeling impulsive about anything, wait. You...can have some later.’
Noah stepped through the entrance of THE Terminus Citadel and felt THE Mortis Cause’s concentrated presence wash over his existence.
It was everywhere.

Not merely in the walls or in the specific structures designed to concentrate it. In the air itself. In the space between the air and the surfaces. In the dimensional geometry of the rooms they passed through, where the obsidian-gold light pulsed in its slow respiratory rhythm and carried with each pulse a small delivery of the Mortis truth into whatever existed in proximity to it.
He thought about Dreamstones.

Surely a Site built specifically to concentrate a Prime Cause contained something analogous to the Dreamstones in THE Sanctum Velanthra, some physical crystallization of the Cause’s presence that permitted direct contact and comprehension in the manner the Bellum and Cognitio stones had provided.

And then he looked at the air around him and felt the threads of Mortis Cause light moving through the space with the ambient persistence of a Cause that had been saturating this location for longer than most of his reference points for duration extended, and a different thought arrived.
The Sanctum Velanthra had required a Dreamstone because the Cause concentration there was not sufficient to produce comprehension through ambient exposure alone.
This place was not THE Sanctum Velanthra as if it was so potent and pervasive all around...could he grasp this terrifying Cause that seemed to be very much in line with Apocalypses and Endings?

chapters.title: Chapter 5240: Veiled Causal Site III
paragraphs: The halls of THE Terminus Citadel ran obsidian-gold, every surface carrying the Mortis Cause light through its geometric seams with the abundance of a Cause that had stopped distinguishing between the material it moved through and the material it was.
Noah floated through them behind Evangelina’s delegation and watched.

The outer halls were populated with Ordovician Paleozoic Scale Gilded Ones attending to the administrative functions of a facility in active use, their auras pressing against his perception in accumulated weight rather than individual intensity. Deeper in, distributed through the secondary corridors in clusters of two and three, the Silurian Paleozoic Scale Gilded Ones appeared.
Too many.

One Silurian Ragnar had ripped him apart without particular effort. The number of beings at equivalent standing moving through these halls with the easy confidence of beings at comfortable baseline was a number he did not attempt to make specific. He simply noted its size and kept walking.
Dietrich’s eyes found him twice across two hallways.
Noah looked ahead and maintained the expression of an innocent man, which he was, essentially, in all the ways Dietrich could currently verify!

The foot traffic thinned as the procession moved deeper. Corridors that had carried continuous movement gave way to corridors carrying occasional movement, then none, then a shimmering obsidian barrier filling the full width of the final corridor from floor to ceiling, its surface rippling with the slow motion of something enforcing entry conditions rather than simply blocking passage.
Three massive titanic Gilded Ones at THE Silurian Paleozoic Scale burning with Ira stood aside as they came closer.
Evangelina walked through without slowing.
Noah stepped through after Adelheid and felt the single step cover more distance than it had any business covering, the barrier not separating two corridors but two scales of space.
He stopped.

The domain on the other side was vast. Inky obsidian in every direction without visible boundary, dense rather than empty, pressing against perception with the weight of a space built to contain something rather than accommodate anyone. No walls. No ceiling. No floor. Just the dark, and at the far end of it, the Obsidian Wall!

It floated in the deep distance with the presence of something permanent, a massive structure of compressed obsidian-gold carrying Mortis Cause saturation so thorough that the Wall itself read less as an object and more as the Cause made physically solid. The gold threading its surface pulsed in the slow rhythm that Noah had already learned to associate with a Prime Cause breathing through what it occupied.
He almost cursed.
Between their position and the Wall, in a guard formation calculated to cover every approach vector, were the Ragnars.
Five hundred of them!

He counted twice. Same number. Five hundred Silurian Paleozoic Scale bodies in the same face, same proportions, each one carrying a density that exceeded the Ragnars from THE Wandering Territories, beings for whom standing between something important and anything approaching it was not a task assigned but an orientation built in.
At their head, one Ragnar larger than the rest.
Noah’s perception touched its foundations and came back with an assessment that sat in a different category than anything he had encountered since entering THE Braneworld.

Devonian Paleozoic Scale. The third and last tier of THE Third Scale of Existence. Three more like it at different cardinal positions around the Wall, each covering a separate approach angle. Four Devonian bodies as the primary layer above the five hundred Silurian ones, obsidian-gold and brutal-smiled and carrying the compound authority of Prime Cause integrations that had been running long enough to become structural rather than accessed.
He absorbed this.
And then felt something further back.

It sat in the deep dark behind the Wall, concealed well enough that most perception directed at it would pass over it. Noah’s Hadean Skull and THE Infinite Tongue’s passive field reached past the concealment and found a presence operating above Devonian.

At the transitional stage between THE Third Scale and THE Fourth Scale, or already beyond it and looking down from there. A single concealed being behind five hundred Silurian Ragnars and four Devonian ones, the actual reason this Wall was treated with the importance it received.
Noah kept his face arranged around mild interest.

Evangelina’s delegation moved toward the Wall. The Devonian Ragnar at the head watched the incoming group with the brutal smile his copies all wore, holding position as the procession entered the domain’s open space.
A second group was already present.

Noah saw Sarees. Crimson-gold, jeweled, the kind worn by beings who understood that how they occupied significant spaces was itself communication. Noah looked at them and thought briefly of Prabhavati, who had worn similar and who was currently in a much better place.
Evangelina’s expression shifted by a degree he had learned to read.
"I did not expect THE Maharanis House to be represented in this round, Sororis Prima Pritta"
The Sororis Prima at the center of the saree-adorned group smiled and let the smile deliver what she wanted it to deliver before she spoke.
"Sororis Prima Evangelina..." She offered the introduction with the ease of someone who did not need introductions to establish standing, only offered them as courtesy.
"The powers above granted us entry alongside THE Ubergulden House. Our House’s recently engineered glory impressed THE Ealdor Gilded Ones sufficiently to authorize his inclusion in this round."
She turned slightly.
"I present to you. Arjun."
Noah looked.

The Gilded One floating several meters behind Pritta’s delegation did not perform his composure. He held it the way people held things that had always simply been true about them, his bearing that of a being who had never needed to negotiate with the concept of an equal because the concept had never been relevant to his experience.

Superbius moved through him like oxygen through blood, present and automatic. His age read as young by Gilded standards in the surface configuration of his features, but his foundations told a different story- three Prime Cause integrations, possibly four, each running at depth, and beneath them something Noah’s Pillow Talk reached for and returned without a clean classification.
One glance at him communicated everything about his standing without the glance’s subject acknowledging it was being taken.
Dietrich frowned.
Pritta’s attention moved to him with her smile still in place.

"Your side has the somewhat exceptional Dietrich. I even heard his little sister made her resurgence?"She let the curiosity sit pleasantly in the air. "Was it Adelheid? Do you think they will be able to survive a place filled with the terrors of THE Primordial Source and make any real contributions to our glory?"
Noah stood let his eyes drift past the exchange toward the Wall.

The political architecture had clarified quickly. THE Ubergulden House and THE Maharanis House were cooperating on the surface of the broader project and actively competing beneath it, each measuring their contribution against the other’s, each fielding their strongest available participants in whatever the Wall led to.

Arjun was THE Maharanis contribution. Adelheid and Dietrich were THE Ubergulden’s. And Noah, in his borrowed identity, was the Custos attached to the Ubergulden entry, which meant his performance on the other side of that Wall would reflect on a House he had every intention of quietly dismantling from within.
He stored this and let his attention complete its drift toward the Wall itself.

The threads of the Mortis Cause moved through the air of this domain at a concentration that exceeded anything in the outer halls, exceeding even the Sanctum Velanthra’s Dreamstone-adjacent density by a margin he could feel but not measure. He had needed physical contact with a Dreamstone to access the Bellum and Cognitio Causes. Physical crystallization of the Cause’s presence as the entry point for comprehension!

chapters.title: Chapter 5241: The Descent!
paragraphs: The Gilded Houses bickered and Noah stopped listening to them.

He turned his attention to the Wall instead and let THE Infinite Tongue’s passive operation extend outward through the ambient Mortis Cause threads filling this domain, reaching for whatever the threads would carry to him about what the Wall was. Pillow Talk engaged alongside it, and the two capabilities pressed against the Wall’s information together.
Existence leaned toward him.
That was the sensation. As though the ambient information surrounding the Wall had been waiting for something capable of asking for it, and Noah’s combined capabilities constituted the asking.
The notifications arrived not in sequence but in overlapping fragments, as though the Wall’s information was too layered to deliver cleanly.
|Wall designation: THE Advent Wall. Object of unknown origin.|

|Connection: THE Mortis Cause saturation throughout all structural components. The Wall does not draw from THE Mortis Cause. It was present at the emergence of THE First Cause and carries THE Mortis Cause’s original expression, preceding the derived methodologies that subsequent beings have developed from it.|

|Discovery: Located through temporal weavings of THE First Cause by Gilded Ones. The temporal weavings traced the Wall backward through time to the moment of THE First Cause’s emergence, confirming it as an object that existed at or before that emergence rather than a construction produced after.|

|Contents: THE Advent Wall carries what has been designated terminal Infinity within its interior weavings, a configuration of Infinity that exists in proximity to cessation rather than to continuation. Alongside this, residual musings of THE Primordial Source have been detected within the Wall’s deepest layers. Whether the Wall connects to THE Primordial Source or merely carries traces of it has not been confirmed.|

|Function: Gilded Ones have utilized THE Advent Wall as a gateway. Entry strips the entering existence of its body, its Civilization foundations, and most of its cultivation substrate. What passes through is the soul of the entrant, surrounded by their Ego, their Infinity, and their Observable Force. The gateway appears to filter everything except these components as impurities relative to whatever lies on the other side.|

|Survival rate: Low. Existences without a close connection to THE First Cause do not survive the filtering process. The Wall’s terminal Infinity interacts fatally with foundations that do not carry sufficient proximity to the original emergence or Mortis.|
|Exception: Lineages born directly from the firstborns of THE First Cause demonstrate markedly higher survival rates.|
Noah’s eyes opened wide.

He looked at the Wall. He looked at Adelheid. He thought about THE Infinite Cause, which his mother had originated, which was the one Cause in the current arrangement of existence that had no Gilded designation, no engineering template, no derivation from the existing Prime Cause framework, because it had emerged independently through the accumulated weight of a Bounded woman’s existence, which made it either the furthest possible thing from THE First Cause’s original emergence or something adjacent to it in a way he had not yet fully mapped.
He put the thought away and watched Evangelina.
She had finished whatever calculation she had been running while the Houses bickered and arrived at its conclusion. She nodded toward the Wall without ceremony.
"If THE Magna Sorora and THE Ealdor Gilded Ones have made the decision, we will naturally act in accordance." Her voice carried the flat certainty of a being who had moved past deliberation.
"Let us proceed. It seems both our houses have high expectations for this round’s picks."
Noah smiled.

High expectations. For the existences they were sending through a wall that stripped everything except the soul, the Ego, and whatever Infinity and Observable Force survived the filtering. Into a space where Ealdor Gilded Ones had stopped entering because the risk to their lives was unacceptable. Where many prior entrants had died or returned gravely injured. Where the survival variable was proximity to THE First Cause’s original emergence.
He thought about what could actually be deployed in such a place.

Body gone. Civilization gone. Most cultivation substrate gone. What remained was the soul, the Ego, the Infinity, and the Observable Force. His Absolute Egos of Infinity were anchored in THE Absolute Forge, which lived inside his Hadean Organ of Civilization. Whether the Forge survived the filtering was an open question.

His Causes would likely survive. Causes, by definition, were not structural components of his physiology but truths that his existence had been formed around, woven into what he was rather than into what he had built. THE Bellum Cause. THE Cognitio Cause. THE Infinite Cause. And THE Infinite Tongue, which was not a Cause but operated through the same layer of his existence.
In a place where everyone else entered with their Ego and their Infinity and little else, he would enter with his Causes and THE Infinite Tongue alongside those.
He filed the advantage and turned his attention back to the space.
Evangelina had moved toward the Devonian Ragnar stationed nearest the Wall, her bearing carrying none of the political performance she had directed at the Maharanis delegation. Operational now!
"Have there been any updates?"She held the Devonian Ragnar’s gaze directly. "New findings from those already inside, or from the Ealdor Gilded Ones who have made the descent?"
The Devonian Ragnar’s brutal smile did not carry warmth and did not pretend to. He shook his head.
"Many of those that have entered so far have been gravely injured. Several died." He looked toward the Wall rather than at Evangelina when he said the next part.
"No more Ealdor Gilded Ones have entered sincr then. They cannot risk their lives until things are clearer on the other side."
Evangelina absorbed this without visible reaction.
"Prepare for our descent."
She turned to Dietrich and Adelheid.
"Come."

The four of them moved toward the Wall, Evangelina at the front, Noah falling into place behind Adelheid as the formation took shape. He raised his brows when he noticed the additional figure joining from Evangelina’s group. A Sororis Prima, pulling into formation beside Dietrich.
Dietrich’s Custos was a Sororis Prima.

Noah looked at Adelheid’s back and at Dietrich moving ahead of them and at the Sororis Prima taking her position beside Dietrich with the settled ease of a Custodes arrangement that had been in place long enough to have its own gravity.
Evangelina did not slow as she spoke, her words directed behind her without turning her head.

"The time has come to see if our forces can once more shine brilliantly for THE Ubergulden House.You are the pioneers. Your task is to pave the path forward and gain enough knowledge that our ancestors can enter without unacceptable risk. Any knowledge on THE Primordial Source. How to tap into it. Anything relating to THE Relictus. That information is what we want, and you will be rewarded tremendously for anything viable."

The Wall grew larger as they approached. The Mortis Cause pulsed through it in its slow rhythm and the terminal Infinity within it pressed against Noah’s perception with the cold patience of something that existed in proximity to ending and had no opinion about what else it was in proximity to.

"If you yourselves grasp THE Primordial Source," Evangelina continued, "you will be elevated and nurtured by our whole House. If you provide the knowledge that paves the way for all Gilded Ones to grasp it, your names will be carved on the Scales themselves. We will make sure of it."

They were close enough now that the Wall filled Noah’s full visual field, its obsidian-gold surface carrying the geometric etchings he had analyzed from across the domain, the functional architecture of a gateway built into material that had existed before THE First Cause had produced anyone to build anything.
"What lies before you is THE Advent Wall," Evangelina said, "It is a boundless future filled with infinite possibilities."
Noah looked at the Wall.

He thought about THE Infinite Cause and its proximity to whatever THE First Cause’s original emergence had been, and about his soul carrying his Causes and his Tongue into a place where Ealdor Gilded Ones had stopped going, and about THE Creature who had grasped THE Primordial Source from the lower Observable Existence with nothing but his rebuilt foundations.
Infinite possibilities.
Infinite possibilities lay ahead as he...was very curious!

Pillow Talk engaged alongside it, and the two capabilities pressed against the Wall’s information together.
Existence leaned toward him.
That was the sensation.
As though the ambient information surrounding the Wall had been waiting for something capable of asking for it, and Noah’s combined capabilities constituted the asking.
The notifications arrived not in sequence but in overlapping fragments, as though the Wall’s information was too layered to deliver cleanly.

chapters.title: Chapter 5242: THE Source Lands! I
paragraphs: A glorious opportunity.

That was the framing Evangelina had used, and Noah did not find it dishonest. The framing just had context around it that she had not emphasized. Ealdor Gilded Ones had stopped entering because the risk to their lives was unacceptable. Many prior entrants had died. By any honest accounting, the Wall was a place where the most powerful beings in the current arrangement of existence had encountered a ceiling on what their power could protect them from.
He was excited!

Not despite the danger. Because of it. Because challenge and risk and adversity compressed progression the way nothing else did, and an unknown space where Ealdor Gilded Ones refused to go was precisely the kind of danger that produced the kind of growth he could not manufacture through any other means. He wanted it to be as dangerous as possible.

And he had THE Infinite Tongue. He had two integrated Prime Causes. He had THE Infinite Cause, which was not a derived expression of THE First Cause but something adjacent to it in a way he had not fully mapped yet.

He thought about THE Creature, who had grasped THE Primordial Source from the lower Observable Existence without transforming into a different category of lifeform, operating through his rebuilt foundations, and who had killed a Gilded One with those tools.
Whatever THE Creature held now was not a small thing.
Infinity and THE Primordial Source together.
If Noah could get his hands on both, the question of what he would be capable of did not have a clean answer.

He was still thinking about this when he became aware that Adelheid’s Infinity, which flowed through her constantly from their bond, was carrying something different in its current. Not words. Something beneath words, a tension in the substrate of what she was generating, slight enough that most beings in his position would not have felt it.
He sent a small mental message through the connection.
’Hey. Don’t worry too much. With me here, I will take care of you.’
He said it calmly. The way a person stated a fact they had no particular investment in debating.

Adelheid did not turn around. But he saw the line of her shoulders shift by a fraction, and he saw the edge of a small smile at the corner of her profile before she composed it back into the regal neutrality she had been maintaining since they left the vessel.
She rolled her eyes!

Ahead of them, the Maharanis delegation had moved into position as well. Arjun floated at their center, unhurried, carrying himself with the specific composure of someone for whom this was simply the next item on a long agenda of grand things. Behind him, a Custodes with bright sparkling bearing and green hair stood close, her power at full Silurian Paleozoic baseline, two additional Silurian Paleozoic Scale Gilded Ones flanking the pair.
Noah looked across both groups.
Objectively, he was the weakest being standing before the Wall. Every other person here outclassed him by tiers.
He thought about how many of them would survive the filtering. And of those who survived the filtering, how many would survive what came after.
The math became more interesting from that angle.
The Custodes behind Arjun turned her head toward him.
"Luxuria shell." Her voice carried the bored certainty of someone not expecting pushback. "Look ahead and stop staring at greatness. Some men are too great to be looked at by lesser men."
Noah’s eyes turned sharp.
He smiled.

By this point in his existence, smack talk from dumb extras produced approximately one reaction, which was patience. Not patience out of restraint. Patience because extras who inserted themselves into a story they did not understand tended to encounter consequences that arrived without him having to manufacture them. Through existence or through his hands. Either way was fine.
He did not reply.

He turned his gaze fully and deliberately toward Arjun and held it there, the exact gesture the Custodes had told him not to make, performed with the serene composure of a being who had heard the instruction and found it interesting rather than binding.
The Maharanis group frowned.

He was the only Luxuria standing in a formation of Superbius and Ira, wearing features in an environment where every other being present was operating at tiers that dwarfed his own, and he was holding eye contact with a Silurian Paleozoic Royal Gilded One with four Prime Cause integrations as though the framing of the situation had simply not occurred to him.
Adelheid’s hand closed around his as she pulled him toward the Wall without waiting for whatever the next moment would have produced, turning her head toward Evangelina as she moved.
"We simply need to touch it to begin the process?"
Evangelina’s face was taut. "Yes. A sliver of your existence will remain here. We will hold it and wait for any information you can send back."
Adelheid did not wait.
She brought her free hand to the Wall and pulled Noah alongside her, and he put his hand against the obsidian-gold surface.
WAP!
Both of them were gone.

Where Adelheid had stood, a golden river of light remained, pulsing with her aura, the sliver of her existence that the Wall had retained as Evangelina had described. It breathed slowly in the domain’s inky dark.
Where Noah had stood, nothing remained.
No river. No pulse. No sliver.
The space was simply empty!
Evangelina and the Ubergulden delegation stared at the empty space with the heavy expressions of beings running calculations they did not want to reach the conclusions of.
Behind them, Sororis Prima Pritta laughed.
The laugh was genuine and carried no attempt at discretion.

"He didn’t even leave behind a sliver?" She looked at the empty space with the delighted expression of someone receiving information that confirmed a prior opinion. "Was that Luxuria scorched out of existence at entry? And now an Ubergulden walks in there alone without a Custodes?"Another laugh, shorter, sharper. "Why would you even bring a Luxuria here? They’re only good to fuck and break, and nobody’s fucking here so what exactly did you expect? Haha."
Ubergulden Dietrich’s expression said several things simultaneously and none of them aloud.
He looked at the empty space where Noah had been standing. He looked at the golden river that was all that remained of his sister.
He moved toward the Wall.

The other Silurian Paleozoic Scale Gilded Ones followed his lead, each one approaching the obsidian-gold surface with the composure of beings who had committed to their descent and were executing the commitment without allowing the empty space where Noah’s sliver should have been to produce further hesitation.
One by one they touched the Wall.
One by one the domain grew quieter.

The golden rivers of their retained existence slivers accumulated along the space before the Wall like a luminous tide of those who had gone somewhere that only their echo remained behind from, each one pulsing with the specific aura of the being it had been left by.
And where Noah had stood, the space remained empty and untroubled, carrying no echo at all!

chapters.title: Chapter 5243: THE Source Lands! II
paragraphs: Most beings do not know what their source is.

A being who has been cultivating for eons, accumulating Civilizations and Causes and engineered Egos and layers of authority built atop layers of authority, cannot easily identify which part of themselves is the substrate and which part is the accumulation, because the accumulation has been present long enough that removing it conceptually feels like removing the self rather than revealing it.
Two schools of thought have emerged from this problem across the long history of beings who cared enough to argue about it.

The first school holds that the source is pure potential, the thing you were before any specific shape was imposed on you by experience or cultivation or circumstance. To return to your source, in this view, is to return to unblemished readiness, a state prior to attachment, prior to identity, prior to the narrowing that happened when you chose this path and not another.

This school finds the source to be a kind of perfection, the best version of what you could have been before you became the specific version of what you are. Returning to it is a gift. A homecoming. The place from which all possibilities remain open because none have yet been chosen.
The second school disagrees.

The second school holds that what you find when you strip away all accumulation is not potential but essence, and essence is not perfect, it is simply true. The source is not the best version of what you could have been. It is the irreducible thing that remains when everything chosen and everything built and everything borrowed has been removed. It is what you are when nothing is helping you.

And for many beings, the second school argues, that irreducible thing is small. It is frightened. It has been hiding inside the accumulation for precisely as long as the accumulation has existed, relieved that the accumulation was there to stand in front of it.
The first school says returning to your source is enlightenment.
The second school says returning to your source is the moment you find out whether there was anything there to return to.
Both schools agree on one thing:the process of returning is not comfortable. Whatever the source turns out to be, it does not want to be found. It has been covered for a reason.
The Wall took everything.

The moment Noah’s hand made contact with THE Advent Wall, the stripping commenced with the sudden comprehensiveness of a process that had been waiting for the contact to authorize it. His Hadean Pillar of Infinity, his bones and organs, his Apeiron engineering, his scales and horns and tail, his accumulated Civilizations, his Hadean Organ and the Absolute Forge within it... all of it departed with the finality of weight being removed from a surface that had been bearing it, each component of his external existence pulled away in a single continuous motion rather than a series of individual removals.
It did not hurt.

That was the first thing that was unexpected. He had anticipated damage. What he experienced instead was reduction, the sensation of a being discovering how much of themselves they had been carrying without noticing the carrying.
Then the chaotic obsidian Infinity hit.

The space inside THE Advent Wall was not space in the sense that the domains he had moved through previously were space. It existed as a continuous roiling storm of obsidian-black Infinity interlaced with threads of something older, something that the Infinity was pressing against and through and around in the way that a river pressed against bedrock, moving around the edges of what it could not move through.
The obsidian Infinity crashed in waves that carried no particular direction, the chaos not random but in the way that things without structure were not random, just without structure.
Noah moved through it.
He looked to his left.

Adelheid was a golden light in the storm. A genuine light, not her Ubergulden authority or her Superbius engineering or any of the accumulated identity she had built across her eons of cultivation. Her source. The gold of it was warm and genuine and smaller than her full expression had been, and it was struggling.

The obsidian waves hit her repeatedly, each wave taking something from her stability, the gold flickering at its edges with the motion of something trying very hard to hold its shape against a pressure it had not been built for.
She looked, Noah thought, like something precious that had been placed somewhere it was not equipped to be.
He went to her.
His own source, moving through the storm, was not small.

Looking at him from outside, anyone present would have seen a blinding multicolored brilliance more than three times the mass of Adelheid’s golden light, its edges stable rather than flickering, the multicolored currents cycling through their full spectrum without interruption from the obsidian chaos crashing against it.

The waves hit him and the waves were redirected. Not through effort. The obsidian Infinity was still Infinity, and THE Infinite Tongue had already been operating at the level of his source before the Wall stripped everything external away, the Tongue not living in his bones or his Civilizations but in what he was beneath those things.
He wrapped his multicolored warmth around her golden light.
|THE Advent Wall- Crossing Phase: Active.|

|You are currently traversing the transitional substrate between Observable Existence and the domain designated THE Primordial Threshold. The Wall functions as a filtering mechanism rather than a barrier. All external components of existence- physical form, cultivated structure, Civilizations, engineered Egos, accumulated methodology...are stripped during crossing and held at the point of entry until the crossing is complete or the attempt fails.|

|What remains after stripping is the Source of the crossing existence: the irreducible core of what the being is prior to cultivation, prior to engineering, prior to any accumulated authority. Only this Source makes the crossing.|

|The obsidian Infinity within the transitional substrate is Terminal Infinity derived from THE Mortis Cause’s original expression. It tests the Source rather than attacking it, pressing against what each being irreducibly is to determine whether that irreducible thing has the structural coherence to survive arrival. Sources that cannot maintain coherence under this pressure dissolve before reaching the other side.|

|Proximity to THE First Cause’s original emergence increases Source coherence under the Terminal Infinity pressure. Lineages with direct connection to THE First Cause’s firstborns experience the pressure as navigable rather than lethal.|

|Your Source is demonstrating coherence at a level the filtering process has not previously recorded. THE Infinite Tongue operates at the Source level rather than the cultivation level. THE Infinite Cause is present in your Source rather than in your accumulated structure. Both remain available to you during crossing.|

|Ubergulden Adelheid: Source coherence under pressure is stable but declining. Your Infinity is providing external stabilization that is compensating for the decline. Crossing will succeed if stabilization holds.|

sentences.text: Most beings do not know what their source is.

A being who has been cultivating for eons, accumulating Civilizations and Causes and engineered Egos and layers of authority built atop layers of authority, cannot easily identify which part of themselves is the substrate and which part is the accumulation, because the accumulation has been present long enough that removing it conceptually feels like removing the self rather than revealing it.
Two schools of thought have emerged from this problem across the long history of beings who cared enough to argue about it.
The first school holds that the source is pure potential, the thing you were before any specific shape was imposed on you by experience or cultivation or circumstance.

To return to your source, in this view, is to return to unblemished readiness, a state prior to attachment, prior to identity, prior to the narrowing that happened when you chose this path and not another.
This school finds the source to be a kind of perfection, the best version of what you could have been before you became the specific version of what you are.
Returning to it is a gift.
A homecoming.
The place from which all possibilities remain open because none have yet been chosen.
The second school disagrees.
The second school holds that what you find when you strip away all accumulation is not potential but essence, and essence is not perfect, it is simply true.
The source is not the best version of what you could have been.
It is the irreducible thing that remains when everything chosen and everything built and everything borrowed has been removed.
It is what you are when nothing is helping you.
And for many beings, the second school argues, that irreducible thing is small.
It is frightened.
It has been hiding inside the accumulation for precisely as long as the accumulation has existed, relieved that the accumulation was there to stand in front of it.
The first school says returning to your source is enlightenment.
The second school says returning to your source is the moment you find out whether there was anything there to return to.
Both schools agree on one thing:the process of returning is not comfortable.
Whatever the source turns out to be, it does not want to be found.
It has been covered for a reason.
The Wall took everything.
The moment Noah’s hand made contact with THE Advent Wall, the stripping commenced with the sudden comprehensiveness of a process that had been waiting for the contact to authorize it.

His Hadean Pillar of Infinity, his bones and organs, his Apeiron engineering, his scales and horns and tail, his accumulated Civilizations, his Hadean Organ and the Absolute Forge within it... all of it departed with the finality of weight being removed from a surface that had been bearing it, each component of his external existence pulled away in a single continuous motion rather than a series of individual removals.
It did not hurt.
That was the first thing that was unexpected.
He had anticipated damage.
What he experienced instead was reduction, the sensation of a being discovering how much of themselves they had been carrying without noticing the carrying.
Then the chaotic obsidian Infinity hit.
The space inside THE Advent Wall was not space in the sense that the domains he had moved through previously were space.

It existed as a continuous roiling storm of obsidian-black Infinity interlaced with threads of something older, something that the Infinity was pressing against and through and around in the way that a river pressed against bedrock, moving around the edges of what it could not move through.
The obsidian Infinity crashed in waves that carried no particular direction, the chaos not random but in the way that things without structure were not random, just without structure.
Noah moved through it.
He looked to his left.
Adelheid was a golden light in the storm.
A genuine light, not her Ubergulden authority or her Superbius engineering or any of the accumulated identity she had built across her eons of cultivation.
Her source.
The gold of it was warm and genuine and smaller than her full expression had been, and it was struggling.

The obsidian waves hit her repeatedly, each wave taking something from her stability, the gold flickering at its edges with the motion of something trying very hard to hold its shape against a pressure it had not been built for.
She looked, Noah thought, like something precious that had been placed somewhere it was not equipped to be.
He went to her.
His own source, moving through the storm, was not small.

Looking at him from outside, anyone present would have seen a blinding multicolored brilliance more than three times the mass of Adelheid’s golden light, its edges stable rather than flickering, the multicolored currents cycling through their full spectrum without interruption from the obsidian chaos crashing against it.
The waves hit him and the waves were redirected.
Not through effort.

The obsidian Infinity was still Infinity, and THE Infinite Tongue had already been operating at the level of his source before the Wall stripped everything external away, the Tongue not living in his bones or his Civilizations but in what he was beneath those things.
He wrapped his multicolored warmth around her golden light.
|THE Advent Wall- Crossing Phase: Active.|
|You are currently traversing the transitional substrate between Observable Existence and the domain designated THE Primordial Threshold.

All external components of existence- physical form, cultivated structure, Civilizations, engineered Egos, accumulated methodology...are stripped during crossing and held at the point of entry until the crossing is complete or the attempt fails.|

chapters.title: Chapter 5244: THE Source Lands! III
paragraphs: Noah read the notifications as his multicolored light wrapped around Adelheid’s gold and held it together, the contact carrying the same warmth their bond had always carried, adjusted now for a space where the bond was not operating through cultivated channels but through whatever their two Sources were to each other at the level below cultivation.
He turned toward the direction the Terminal Infinity seemed to be flowing away from.

The obsidian chaos pressed against his multicolored Source and found it uncooperative. He moved through the waves the way something moved through water when the water was also listening to it, the obsidian Infinity around him not yielding out of weakness but responding to the Tongue that lived in what he was rather than in what he had built, each wave that reached his edges receiving a quiet instruction about its direction that the wave honored without apparent objection.
He guided Adelheid through the storm.

She did not speak and he did not speak. The space was not a speaking space. But he could feel through the connection between their Sources that the flickering at her edges had steadied from the moment his multicolored warmth had closed around her, the gold holding its shape with the assistance rather than fighting to hold it alone.
They moved!
Behind and around them in the transitional substrate, the others crossed.

The Maharanis delegation was visible as separate points of light in the obsidian storm, each one carrying its own Source configuration. Arjun burned the brightest among them, a deep gold-blue with the compound density of a Source that had been formed in extraordinary proximity to THE First Cause’s influence through his lineage’s long history with the prime Cause integrations his House was known for.

He moved through the obsidian chaos without ease but with the competence of someone who had trained for exactly this for a very long time, the waves hitting him and taking something from his stability with each contact but never enough at once to threaten the crossing.

His Custodes was less composed. The bright green of her Source flared with every wave hit, her light spiking and recovering in quick irregular rhythms, the recovery more effortful each time. She was pulling through. Not without cost!
The Ubergulden delegation was harder to watch.

Dietrich’s Source was strong- deep gold, broad, carrying the accumulated weight of his House’s direct lineage from THE First Cause’s Superbius expression. But the obsidian storm found him repeatedly and found purchase each time, his gold dimming and recovering across the crossing in a pattern that communicated something being spent that he did not have infinite amounts of.

His Sororis Prima Custodes blazed beside him with the combined authority of a Custodes bond pulling power toward its Ingenue, the two of them fighting through together in the way that Custodes partnerships were designed to do when circumstances required it.
The others in the group were struggling outright.

Two of the Ubergulden Silurian Paleozoic Scale Gilded Ones had their Sources compressed down to fractions of their initial expressions by the time the crossing was a third complete, the obsidian waves taking chunks rather than edges, their coherence declining in a way that made the question of their survival not an assumption but an open calculation.
Nothing about any of it looked like what it had looked like for Noah!

For Noah, moving through the storm with Adelheid’s gold cradled inside his multicolored brilliance, the crossing looked like a being walking through a difficult rain. The rain was real and the rain was heavy and the rain was soaking anyone else nearby to the skin and beyond.
He was not getting wet!
The obsidian chaos deepened as they pushed further through.
The waves had been manageable at the crossing’s start, each one hitting and being redirected by THE Infinite Tongue’s passive operation with the ease of water being told it had somewhere else to be.

Twenty minutes into the crossing, the waves were larger and the intervals between them had compressed until there were no intervals, just continuous pressure from every direction simultaneously, the Terminal Infinity pressing against their Sources with the sustained thoroughness of a filtering process that had been designed to take as long as the Source required it to take.
Noah moved through it.

Adelheid’s gold was holding inside his multicolored light, steadier than it had been at the start, the warmth of his Infinity doing what the prompts had confirmed it was doing. He kept her wrapped and kept moving and directed the obsidian waves around them with the continuous low-level engagement of a being for whom the control was not effortful but constant.
Then something changed in the direction of down.

It was not a sound and not a vibration and not any of the sensory categories that ordinarily communicated incoming danger. It was the specific sensation of his Hadean perception ringing out an alarm at an intensity that exceeded the alarm it had produced for the concealed Fourth Scale being in the domain where THE Advent Wall stood.
That being had been above Devonian Paleozoic Scale. This sensation was above that!
He looked down.
In the obsidian depths below their position, something was rising.

Two eyes. Crimson and cold, each one larger than the entirety of Noah’s Source expression, blinking with the slow brutality of a predator that had identified something and was in no particular hurry about what came next. The eyes rose with the patience of something that had always been here and knew that everything here eventually came to it!
Noah did not deliberate.

He smashed his hand downward into the obsidian chaos and shot their combined Source expression forward with every ounce of Infinity he could drive into the motion, the two of them rocketing through the terminal substrate at a velocity he had no clean measurement for, the obsidian waves shattering against the force of their passage rather than impeding it.
They broke through!
WAP!

The landing was jagged rock and coarse dark sand, their Sources smashing into a surface that was solid and wrong and present after the formless chaos of the crossing, and Noah absorbed the impact through his multicolored light and pulled Adelheid upright before looking behind them.
The obsidian sea churned where they had emerged from it.

Where they had just been, the entire visible expanse of crossing substrate had been devoured, a void left behind that raging dark waters rushed in to fill, the Terminal Infinity replaced by something darker and older and considerably less interested in testing Sources than in consuming them!
Fuck!
And rising from the edge of that void, its body moving through the space where the obsidian chaos had been with the ease of a being for whom this was simply water, was the creature.

Ancient. Archaic! The body of an eel stretched across more distance than his perception could currently track at its ends, its skin carrying the specific texture of something that had never been any other shape and would never need to be, its scales dark and absolute and carrying faint luminescence from whatever it had recently consumed. Its two crimson eyes found Noah across the distance between them with the particular attention of something noting a meal rather than a threat.
Above its head, a notification appeared.
|Source Eel of Infinity — THE Fourth Scale of Existence. ???????|

chapters.title: Chapter 5245: THE Source Lands! IV
paragraphs: Noah looked at the notification.
He looked at the eel as it receded into the dark and chaotic waters.

He did not curse. He made a note that the Fourth Scale welcome party was a good sign about how dangerous this place would be, and left the eel as a problem to solve after he understood where he was, and turned away from the churning dark waters to examine the beach they had landed on.

The beach was rough and dark, jagged rock breaking through the coarse sand at irregular intervals, the landscape stretching away from the water’s edge into terrain that he could barely perceive the outlines of. This was the most significant thing: he could not see far.

Not because the darkness was absolute, though it was darker here than any darkness he had previously encountered, but because his perception, which had been capable of ranging across countless gigaparsecs in Observable Existence, currently extended approximately a mile before meeting a hard limit that did not feel like obstruction but like the edge of what the environment permitted.
One mile.
The obsidian rivers flowing through the surrounding terrain began resonating against his Source, and information started arriving.
|Arrival confirmed. Welcome to THE Source Lands.|

|State of existence: All external components have been stripped at THE Advent Wall. Your physical body, your Hadean Physiology, your Civilizations, your Absolute Egos, your Hadean Pillar of Infinity, and all Ways of Existence are null and void in this place. What remains is your Source, the irreducible core of what you are, alongside the following components which have survived stripping intact: your Infinity, your Observable Force, and your links to THE Bellum Cause, THE Cognitio Cause, and THE Infinite Cause. THE Infinite Tongue is present, as it operates at the Source level rather than the cultivation level.|

|In THE Source Lands, the only meaningful currency is the Source itself. Civilizations do not function here. Engineered architecture does not function here. What each existence is at its irreducible core is what it has to work with, amplified to an extreme degree by the nature of this place.|

|All existences here experience base emotions, hungers, and biological drives at extreme intensity. Anger. Pride. Arrogance. Lust. Fear. Pain. These are not cultivated expressions but raw Source states, and in this place they press against consciousness with a force that even the most disciplined minds struggle to manage. This is not a flaw in the environment. It is a feature of the stripping, when accumulation is removed, what it was suppressing becomes louder.|

|Hunger is the critical condition. Every Source in THE Source Lands burns constantly against the ambient elements, which continuously sap it. A Source that is not replenished will eventually exhaust itself and collapse. The primary replenishment mechanism is consumption, consuming other Sources restores one’s own. This can be other lifeforms or resources on these lands. This produces the fundamental condition of THE Source Lands: every existence here is either hunting or being hunted. There are no neutral parties. There is no rest.|
|If Hunger reaches a critical threshold, the Source begins consuming itself. Below 10% Satiety, self-consumption accelerates exponentially. At zero, the existence ends.|
|Demarcation System of Sources:|

|First Demarcation-Seidr Source: A Source that barely coheres under the pressure of THE Source Lands’ environment. These existences are the majority present here. They are capable of sustaining themselves only by consuming multiple weaker Sources rapidly, as their own reserves exhaust quickly. Most First Demarcation Sources collapse within the first cycle of this place’s equivalent of a day.|

|Second Demarcation-Galdr Source: A Source of sufficient strength and coherence to interact actively with the environment of THE Source Lands rather than simply surviving it. Second Demarcation Sources can direct the obsidian rivers, resist ambient elemental sapping to a meaningful degree, and engage with other Sources from a position of genuine strength rather than desperation. They are rare. Most Gilded Ones who survive the crossing arrive at First Demarcation.|

|Third Demarcation —Einherjar Source: A Source capable of commanding aspects of THE Source Lands itself, bending the ambient elements to its will and consuming First and Second Demarcation Sources at will. These exist, but they are encountered rather than common. They hold territories. They have been here long enough that the question of where they came from in time no longer has a clean answer.|

|Note: THE Source Lands exist outside of time as Observable Existence defines it. Those present may be from eons past, eons future, or any point within that span, all occupying the same space simultaneously. The concept of a timeline does not apply here.|

|Your Source Demarcation:Second.Galdr Source. Your Infinity is sufficient in its density and expression to produce a Galdr Source directly upon arrival. Your Source is currently elevating to match the Demarcation your Infinity established.|

|Progression: If a Source rises high enough through combat, consumption, and confrontation with the ambient elements of this place, access to THE Primordial Tongue becomes possible. Those who achieve this gain the letters of the oldest language. THE Primordial Source itself lies beyond even this. It is not attained. It is either carried from birth or approached through adversity so extreme that most existences collapse long before proximity becomes relevant.|
|This place is simultaneously the most dangerous and the most accelerating environment for Source development in existence.|
|Welcome.|
BOOM!
Noah blinked.

His Infinity rearranged itself around his Source with the specific efficiency of a system reconfiguring to new operational parameters, the multicolored currents cycling through him in patterns adapted to this place rather than the patterns that had served him in Observable Existence. He felt the difference immediately. The sensory fullness was extraordinary- the sand under his feet, the cold of the air, the smell of the dark water behind them, all of it arriving at an intensity that his cultivated existence had been filtering for so long that he had forgotten the unfiltered version existed.
He also felt hungry.

Not the cultivated awareness of needing to replenish reserves. Actual hunger, the raw biological version that he had last felt when he was a young man eating whatever the apocalypse left available. It pressed against his concentration with the insistence of a condition that had been waiting a very long time to be acknowledged.
A status panel bloomed at the edge of his perception.
|Source Status — Noah Osmont|
|Designations: THE Genesis Monarch / THE Youngest / THE Primus Apeiron / THE Infinite Speaker / THE Osmontian|
|Source: Emergent — Elevating /Galdr Source|
|Infinity: Nearu Absolute /Galdr|
|Observable Force: Galdr|
|Cause Links Active: THE Bellum Cause / THE Cognitio Cause / THE Infinite Cause|
|THE Infinite Tongue: Active at Source level|
|Satiety: 27%|

|Warning: Your Infinity expression at this Demarcation produces Source sapping at an accelerated rate relative to most Second Demarcation existences. Your Source requires significantly greater replenishment volume than others at equivalent standing. Consumption must commence soon. At 10% Satiety, self-consumption begins.|
Noah looked at the 27% and looked at the warning and looked at the dark landscape stretching beyond the mile his perception could reach.
He pulled Adelheid upright from the jagged sand.

She was catching her breath, her golden Source expression cycling through the visible emotions this place amplified straight to the surface- residual fear from the crossing, the disorientation of having her Ubergulden identity stripped back to its raw core, the specific vulnerability of a being who had spent eons constructing an exterior discovering that the exterior was not present anymore.
He checked her status without asking. Her Source was First Demarcation, stable but thin, her Satiety already higher than his at 70%.
He looked behind them at the obsidian waters.
He looked at the distant crimson eyes of the Source Eel still watching from the border of the void it had created.
He looked at the dark landscape ahead where anything from eons past or eons future might be waiting in the mile beyond his perception.

Twenty-seven percent Hunger and falling, in a place where the only replenishment was consuming something else’s Source or resources, in a space without time where a Fourth Scale creature had been the welcome party.
He had arrived at a truly glorious place!
